results.title: Dan Orlovsky stumped by Mina Kimes’ Alamo reference
results.description: Dan Orlovsky is an NFL analyst across ESPN platforms, most prominently on the award-winning NFL Live. He’s also a professional oversharer. Orlovsky has made a habit out of captivating the nation with his unique habits, leading to a bland grilled chicken birthday cake, and his character arc regarding pedicures.
